name: Last Line: The 88
summary: Last Line: The 88 is a free browser-based stick-figure action game by Forbidden Fruit Productions and an arcade spin-off of Last Line. In The 88 mode, one to four players fight through eighty-eight opponents as the page changes between notebook, flipbook, pop-up, shadow-puppet, ink-wash, comic, film and blue-pen styles. Page turns restore health and introduce abilities such as wall running, dash-slashing and bullet deflection. Versus mode supports up to four fighters with character-specific specials, shields and supers on stages with moving platforms, springs and folding flaps. The game supports local and online multiplayer, room codes, quick matching, controllers, keyboard and touch controls.
